mapper.select: SELECT id FROM pt_coach WHERE id = #{coachId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT ROUND(IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.tradeType = 2 THEN -d.money ELSE d.money END) FROM coach_trade_detail d WHERE d.coachId = #{coachId} AND d.status = 1 AND d.transactionNumber REGEXP '^PT_(LESSON|MONTHLY|SALE)_' ), 0), 2) AS incomeTotal, ROUND(IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(w.actual_settlement_amount) FROM pt_coach_withdrawal w WHERE w.coach_id = #{coachId} AND w.status = 2 ), 0), 2) AS settledAmount, ROUND(IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(w.frozen_amount) FROM pt_coach_withdrawal w WHERE w.coach_id = #{coachId} AND w.status = 0 ), 0), 2) AS frozenAmount

SELECT id, requested_amount AS requestedAmount, settlement_amount AS settlementAmount, actual_settlement_amount AS actualSettlementAmount, frozen_amount AS frozenAmount, account_name AS accountName, bank_name AS bankName, bank_card_no AS bankCardNo, attachment_urls AS attachmentUrls, status, review_remark AS reviewRemark, DATE_FORMAT(reviewed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS reviewedAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM pt_coach_withdrawal WHERE coach_id = #{coachId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pt_coach_withdrawal WHERE coach_id = #{coachId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pt_coach_withdrawal (coach_id, requested_amount, settlement_amount, frozen_amount, account_name, bank_name, bank_card_no, attachment_urls, status) VALUES (#{coachId}, #{requestedAmount}, #{settlementAmount}, #{frozenAmount}, #{accountName}, #{bankName}, #{bankCardNo}, '[]', 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, coach_id AS coachId, requested_amount AS requestedAmount, settlement_amount AS settlementAmount, actual_settlement_amount AS actualSettlementAmount, frozen_amount AS frozenAmount, status, attachment_urls AS attachmentUrls FROM pt_coach_withdrawal WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT w.id, w.coach_id AS coachId, c.coach_no AS coachNo, c.coach_name AS coachName, c.mobile, w.requested_amount AS requestedAmount, w.settlement_amount AS settlementAmount, w.actual_settlement_amount AS actualSettlementAmount, w.frozen_amount AS frozenAmount, w.account_name AS accountName, w.bank_name AS bankName, w.bank_card_no AS bankCardNo, w.attachment_urls AS attachmentUrls, w.status, w.review_remark AS reviewRemark, DATE_FORMAT(w.reviewed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS reviewedAt, DATE_FORMAT(w.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM pt_coach_withdrawal w INNER JOIN pt_coach c ON c.id = w.coach_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE w.id = #{id}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_coach_store_rel r WHERE r.coach_id = w.coach_id AND r.store_id IN (${storeIds}))
mapper.update: UPDATE pt_coach_withdrawal SET settlement_amount = #{settlementAmount}, actual_settlement_amount = #{actualSettlementAmount}, frozen_amount = 0, attachment_urls = #{attachmentUrls}, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), status = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0

UPDATE pt_coach_withdrawal SET frozen_amount = 0, attachment_urls = #{attachmentUrls}, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), status = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
